repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

Authorization callout service users can be exempted from callouts so the service can connect without recursively invoking itself.

### Problem Description

The exemption decision could use client-supplied identity fields that did not correspond to the credentials actually authenticated. A connection could be treated as an exempt service user and skip the external authorization decision. This bypass did not require possession of the exempt identity’s credentials, although other local authentication requirements could still apply.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-vqv6-8g5v-c9c4>
 * Credit: ARSB (@ARSB1)
repo.summary: Client-supplied identity fields can bypass authorization callouts
